parameters.name: CalType
parameters.description: The old or new version of the security score rule. If you set this parameter to **home_security_score**, the new version of the security score rule is changed. Otherwise, the old version of the security score rule is changed by default.

parameters.name: ResetSecurityScoreRule
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to reset to the system default rule. Valid values:

*   true: yes
*   false: no

parameters.name: SecurityScoreCategoryList
parameters.description: The information about the new version of the security score rule.

sub_parameters.name: Category
sub_parameters.description:
The category of the security score rule. Valid values:

*   **SS_SAS_HANDLE**: security governance.
*   **SS_SAS_RESPOND**: security response.

sub_parameters.name: ScoreThreshold
sub_parameters.description:
The threshold of deduction for the security score rule type.

>  Valid values: 0 to 100. The sum of the deduction thresholds for all deduction modules must be equal to 100.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityRuleList
sub_parameters.description: The deduction items of the security score rule.

parameters.name: SecurityScoreRuleList
parameters.description: The information about the old version of the security score rule.

sub_parameters.name: RuleType
sub_parameters.description:
The type of the security score rule. Valid values:

*   SS_REINFORCE: issue in key feature configuration
*   SS_ALARM: unhandled alert
*   SS_VUL: unfixed vulnerability
*   SS_HC: baseline risk
*   SS_CLOUD_HC: risk item of configuration assessment
*   SS_AK: risk of AccessKey pair leaks

sub_parameters.name: Score
sub_parameters.description:
The deduction threshold of the deduction module.

>  Valid values: 0 to 100. The sum of the deduction thresholds for all deduction modules must be equal to 100.

sub_parameters.name: SecurityScoreItemList
sub_parameters.description: The deduction items of the deduction module.
